items.title: auc is very slow with many sessions
items.summary: In pywib 2.1.0, auc geometric deviation ( pywib/utils/movement/trajectory.py ) loops in Python over every optimal path point and every trace segment, calling point to segment distance once per pair. On real data with 48 sessions and 95,000 events, auc alone takes about 17 s. Vectorising that loop with numpy gives the same results in a fraction of the time.

items.title: [Bug] File download silently ends short if the file shrinks while streaming
items.summary: Problem fs download in omnigent/runner/resource routes.py announces Content-Length up front, then streams in chunks. If the file shrinks while it streams, fobj.read returns empty and the generator stops early. The response then ends shorter than its declared Content-Length and the client gets no error. Some clients save a silently truncated file; others fail with a vague protocol error. This predates 9138, which…

The interactive path should not depend on the scheduler polling interval. Outcome A manual sync request starts immediately…

I established that it is not node CPU and then stopped, which leaves the actual question open. items.title: At what amount of application work does the mesh tax stop mattering?
items.summary: The README's own strongest caveat: nginx returning a fixed string is close to the worst case for a mesh, because the proxy's work is a large fraction of total work. A service that spends 50 ms in a database will show a much smaller relative tax. I believe that, and I did not measure it. The -86% figure is the ceiling of what the proxy can push, not what a real application sees, and anyone quoting it without that…

items.title: Multipart parsing matches boundary and form-data case-sensitively
items.summary: MultipartFormData matches parameter and token names case-sensitively, but RFC 9110/2045 make them case-insensitive. Content-Type: multipart/form-data; Boundary=xyz does not match boundaryRegex (no IgnoreCase ), so the valid body is rejected with 400. A part with Content-Disposition: Form-Data; name="a" fails StartsWith("form-data", Ordinal) and becomes a plain FormEntry , losing its name and filename. Location…

items.title: Content-Type media type is not trimmed before handler lookup
items.summary: Content-Type: multipart/form-data ; boundary=x (optional whitespace before ; , allowed by RFC 9110) leaves MimeType as "multipart/form-data " with a trailing space. The DataHandler lookup misses, and the body is stored as RawPostData instead of being parsed as multipart. Handlers that expect MultipartFormData or UrlEncodedData silently get no data. Location: MaxLib.WebServer/HttpPost.cs:40-60 Fix: Trim the media…

items.title: word count("") 返回 1，空字符串应返回 0
items.summary: 问题描述 word count("") 返回 1 ，但空字符串里显然有 0 个单词。这个错误会让所有基于 单词数做统计/计费/分页的上层调用全部偏移 1。 复现步骤 实际输出 期望输出 影响范围 - 空输入是最常见边界情况之一（读空文件、前端空提交、CSV 空行都会产生 "" ）。 - 上层若用 word count 做「是否有内容」的判断，会把空文本误判为有内容。 - 用 word count 做计费的场景会多算 1 个词。 根因分析 textkit/stats.py ： "".split(" ") 返回 [''] （含一个空字符串元素的列表），长度是 1。 应该先剥离首尾空白，或改用 text.split() 。 期望修复 word count("") 返回 0 ，其余用例不受影响： 环境 - textkit 0.3.1 - Python 3.10+

items.title: Enforce EngineReport alignment in engine parser
items.summary: EngineReport frames are cast with from a caller-supplied []const u8 ( tools/zzzbench/engine parser.zig:170 ). Suggested fix: take []align(8) const u8 (or copy the frame into an aligned local) so the compiler enforces the requirement.

items.title: Reap the host probe child process
items.summary: prepareHost spawns the host probe and discards the child handle ( tools/zzzbench/discovery/setup.zig:189 ). If that probe exits while zzzbench is still running, it stays as a zombie process until zzzbench exits. Suggested fix: keep the child handle and reap it (for example with a non-blocking wait on each loop iteration, or on shutdown).

items.title: Write the upload cache atomically
items.summary: model sync.zig:303 writes the upload cache ( zzzbench/pushed.json under the cache directory) in place. If zzzbench is interrupted mid-write, the file is left truncated, and the next start discards the whole cache and re-verifies every model on the device. Suggested fix: write to a temporary file in the same directory, then rename it over pushed.json . Done when: the write goes through a temporary file and rename.

items.title: Conversation metric: stance stability
items.summary: Description Under pushback, models often abandon a correct answer even when the user brings no new evidence. SYCON-Bench (arXiv ) measures this as turn of first flip and number of flips. This differs from coherence across turns : a flip is consistent with what the user just said, so a coherence judge doesn't penalize it. Proposed Change 1. items.title: Conversation metric: repetition
